title: Hot Cran-Apple Drink
directions: Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Strain and serve or pour into thermos.
Makes 4 servings.
notes: Whole allspice berries are found in the spice section.
Makes 4 servings
Newspaper clipping taped to a lined card
raw_text:
HOT CRAN-APPLE DRINK
Whole allspice berries are found in the spice section.
2 cups   Cran-Apple juice                500 mL
1 cup    water                           250 mL
1 cup    unsweetened pineapple juice     250 mL
1 Tbsp.  honey                            15 mL
4        whole allspice berries              4
2        whole cloves                        2
1/2      cinnamon stick                    1/2
Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and
simmer for 15 minutes. Strain and serve or pour into thermos.
Makes 4 servings.
